correctness.rationale: Exact sinc-factorization gives the first three pair-distance power sums. Their symbolic expansion and elimination yield \(H(P)=16E^3-15EF+39FP-156EP^2+156P^3\). Every physical candidate has \(P>E/3\) and \(D(P)=(P-W)^2-4Q>0\), while \(D(E/3)<0\) and \(D\) increases on \(P>E/3\); thus the inverse cubic has at most one admissible root. An explicit distinct rational-parameter geometry shares the second- and fourth-order moment data and hence the lower-order intensity jet. Bundled CHECK.py verifies all critical identities, the lower-jet example, and 500 rational configurations. No finite experiment is substituted for the infinite proof.
